_note: Deadlock is hidden from Steam's public player-count API and from SteamCharts, so there is no continuous series. These are the monthly peaks that could be verified: figures attributed to SteamDB by the cited articles, plus the sampled 10-minute record of steamdb.com (a different site from steamdb.info) which only exists since 2026-07-02 and is therefore a lower bound. Months that are not listed are unknown, not zero.
